title: New Line says "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters" at 256
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, so a saved line can be added to it.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Line.
  2. Paste a 255-character title into the Title box: 0123456789 written 25 times in a row, then 01234 (255 characters; paste it in).
  3. Type "5" at the end of the title.
  4. Click Save & Close.
  5. Press Backspace.
  6. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens over work order 1, with an empty Title field.

Step 2:

  • The Title box holds the 255 characters, ending in "01234".
  • No message shows under the Title box.

Step 3:

  • The title now has 256 characters, ending in "012345".
  • "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters" shows under the Title box (not "Line name cannot be longer than 255 characters long").

Step 4:

  • The window stays open and the line is not saved.
  • "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters" still shows under the Title box.

Step 5:

  • The last "5" is removed, so the title has 255 characters again.
  • The message under the Title box is gone.

Step 6:

  • The window closes.
  • Work order 1's Lines tab lists the new line, whose title ends in "01234": 255 characters can be saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog)

  • S1-R6: “Leaving Title empty blocks the save with the message "Title is a required field", replacing "Line Name is a required field". Every required-field message in the app uses the "X is a required field" form, and this one keeps it. The message shows under the Title box whenever Title is in error, including when the user leaves it empty, the same as every other field in the dialog (SV-10916). A Title longer than 255 characters shows "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters" from the 256th character, replacing "Line name cannot be longer than 255 characters long", and the line cannot be saved while it shows.”

From: Product's answers to our questions 9-14 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc 1QcT7FRZci6AhYcI33HUac-Oob03-gCnCOKn2NFHMLjA, saved in po-answers-2026-10-27/), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Answer 9: “9. (a) Yes, "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters", from the 256th character, and the line can't be saved while it shows. (b) Yes, before it said "Line name cannot be longer than 255 characters long", so only the wording changed (S1-R6).”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-11257, and bug SV-11850 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10130, Nemanja Djuric, 19 Oct 2026 (QA update, PRD v14): “New Line and Edit Line: type 256 characters into Title. "Title cannot be longer than 255 characters" shows and Save & Close is blocked; delete one character and it clears.”
